import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_41/test_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_41/test_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_41/test_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_41/test_3.csv"
]

# Mapping of source label values to target label integers
label_mapping = {
    'g': 1,
    'r': 1,
    'purple': 1,
    'b': 1
}

# List to hold transformed DataFrames
dfs = []

for file_path in source_files:
    # Read CSV with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    
    # Ensure columns are exactly ['x', 'y', 'label']
    # According to source info, all have these columns
    
    # Convert 'x' to integer by rounding (since target schema x is integer)
    # Source 'x' is float, target 'x' is integer
    df['x'] = df['x'].round().astype(int)
    
    # Convert 'y' to float (already float, but ensure dtype)
    df['y'] = df['y'].astype(float)
    
    # Map label strings to integer 1 (all source labels map to 1)
    # Defensive: if label not in mapping, raise error
    if not df['label'].isin(label_mapping.keys()).all():
        unknown_labels = df.loc[~df['label'].isin(label_mapping.keys()), 'label'].unique()
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown label values found in {file_path}: {unknown_labels}")
    df['label'] = df['label'].map(label_mapping).astype(int)
    
    # Reorder columns to target schema order: ['y', 'x', 'label']
    df = df[['y', 'x', 'label']]
    
    dfs.append(df)

# Since all source tables have the same schema as target, union (concat) all
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the target CSV file
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_41/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)
